Layout: each post is printed as a run-on paragraph 'POST (details): Name, Position; Name, Position.' — split one row per person. Post names printed in small capitals are given in Title Case. Parenthetical addresses/telephone numbers after the post name are in 'Post details'; parentheticals after a position (e.g. '(Nanking)', '(Tel. 36747)') are kept in 'Position'.

Where one plural position follows several names (e.g. 'Secretaries of Legation', 'Typists', 'Consuls'), each name gets a row with that plural position as printed; prefixes such as 'Misses', 'Capts.', '1st Lts.' are kept on the first name they precede, as printed.
Belgium: the first entry has no post label printed (the ambassador and legation staff); Post left blank.
